reason: The patch's fetch_error_details pairs IDs and data with `zip(error_ids, events.values())` (patch line ~729). It does not look up each event by its node_id key. In src/sentry/nodestore/base.py:184-210, get_multi removes duplicate ids, adds cached items after the fetched ones (`items.update(cache_items)`), and leaves out entries the backend does not return, so the values can come back in a different order or count than error_ids and get matched to the wrong IDs.
